pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark regions with smooth-to-slightly-rounded edge gradients. Individual patches show high spatial area relative to the width of the light separators.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of thin, light-colored interstices. Junction nodes predominantly consist of three-way and four-way intersections with relatively uniform pixel thickness across the neck and shoulder.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane silhouette along the upper neck exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated contour composed of distinct hair-tuft projections.
